design_probes.design_claim: The official v016 route applies one locomotion Reward to zero and nonzero commands and carries it through production replay into privileged SAC updates without mode dispatch.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Activate both command roles, preserve Reward identity in ReplayBuffer, and update production Critic and Actor once without mode telemetry.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 rows, one control transition, 128 replay samples, one Critic update, and one Actor update.
design_probes.falsifier: Absent zero or nonzero command rows, a mode log, Reward mismatch, non-finite update, or unchanged Actor.
design_probes.success_witness: 11 zero-command rows, 21 nonzero-command rows, no mode logs, 128 reward-identical samples, finite metrics, and an Actor parameter delta.

design_probes.design_claim: The official v016 profile retains two legacy Actor slots but removes gait-clock authority from reset, observation, and step.
design_probes.necessary_capability: A real production G1 reset and step expose exact zeros in both final Actor positions while retaining 98-D input.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 real MuJoCo rows, one reset, and one zero-action control transition.
design_probes.falsifier: Either phase slot is nonzero at reset or after step, or Actor input is not 98-D.
design_probes.success_witness: All reset and post-step rows had exact zero final two Actor positions and Actor/Critic remained 98/303.

design_probes.design_claim: The official v016 privileged profile materializes only nominal and left-knee attenuation rows without changing Actor input.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Apply the production actuator-strength owner in MuJoCo and expose applied strength through typed privileged Kp/Kd scales.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 real MuJoCo rows and one reset under a fixed seed.
design_probes.falsifier: Any non-index-3 actuator varies, the multiplier escapes [0.8,1.0], or a required stratum is absent.
design_probes.success_witness: Both nominal and attenuated index-3 rows occurred and every unrelated actuator scale stayed one.

design_probes.design_claim: The v016 effective config identity survives strict checkpoint restoration and one exact 20+1 Oracle lineage.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Round-trip full learner state after deliberate mutation and finalize iterations 240 through 4800 plus 5000 through the production gateway.
design_probes.minimal_case: One full model_240 save/reload and 21 temporary lifecycle saves through the bound gateway.
simplifications: tiny payloads for remaining lineage files
design_probes.falsifier: Failed restoration, config identity mismatch, missing or extra checkpoint, or wrong final iteration.
design_probes.success_witness: A deliberately mutated Actor restored exactly and the manifest recorded 21 hashes ending at 5000.

design_probes.design_claim: The production server collector subprocess and CUDA learner carry v016 identities through the first live update.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Complete one MuJoCo collector to CPU-pinned double-buffer to CUDA learner transaction with both command roles and Gain strata represented.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 environments and the first finite live update, bounded by 120 seconds.
design_probes.falsifier: Collector, phase, command-role, Gain, tensor, transfer, CUDA, lifecycle, numeric, or write-boundary failure.
design_probes.success_witness: One finite CUDA learner update whose batch retains phase-neutral Actor slots and contains both command roles and Gain strata.

claims.scope: The official local v016 profile keeps phase slots zero and carries one real Reward for both command roles through replay into one finite privileged SAC update.
The v016 cold-start identity strictly round-trips full state and finalizes one exact 20+1 lineage.
One local MuJoCo reset and step preserved 98/303/29 identity, zero phase slots, and left-knee-only Gain strata.

negative_scope: No server CUDA collector transaction, long training, convergence, locomotion quality, Planner-IDM readiness, commit, push, or deployment is claimed.
Local evidence does not prove 5000-iteration stability or privileged Oracle policy quality.
